disclaimer: Research-level register, not legal advice. Every entry lists what was actually read and when. Anything marked needsDecision must be resolved by a human (with counsel where noted) before public launch.

tcpd-nc.name: TCPD Lok Dhaba (Ashoka University) - free for non-commercial use with citation
constraints: do not redistribute raw TCPD files
tcpd-nc.attribution: Source: Trivedi Centre for Political Data (TCPD), Ashoka University, Lok Dhaba. Cite: Agarwal, Ananay et al. 2021 (see the TCPD citation page).
tcpd-nc.decision: Is the public site non-commercial? Any ad, sponsorship, paid tier or consultancy use breaks the NC term. Counsel to confirm that publishing derived per-seat results under NC is permitted, or obtain written permission from TCPD.
tcpd-nc.evidence: The NC term was read in the README of github.com/in-rolls/eci_results on 2026-11-22 ('free for non-commercial use with citation'). The Lok Dhaba site itself was unreachable (connection refused) from the build machine, so the exact licence variant (CC BY-NC vs BY-NC-SA) is UNVERIFIED.

census-orgi-2011.name: Census of India 2011 (Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner), Census Digital Library
census-orgi-2011.attribution: Source: Census of India 2011, Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner, India (District Census Handbooks village and town directories).
census-orgi-2011.decision: The catalogue entries show only 'Rights: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India (ORGI)' and no open licence. The files download without login. Counsel to confirm redistribution of derived village/town counts; alternatively obtain the data via data.gov.in under GODL-India (needs a key).
census-orgi-2011.evidence: Catalogue entry catalog/123 read 2026-11-22; downloads of resources 144 and 145 returned HTTP 200 with no login. 2026-11-24: Primary Census Abstract workbooks (catalog/6723 to 6745, one per 2011 district, and catalog/6191 state and district level) read and downloaded with HTTP 200 and no login; those pages carry no rights text beyond the site footer (c) ORGI Digital Library, All Rights Reserved. Literacy counts (P_LIT, P_06) come from these files.

datameet-nc-sa.name: DataMeet or other datasets under CC BY-NC-SA
datameet-nc-sa.decision: Do not ship any other NC-SA dataset without a human decision on the non-commercial restriction and share-alike obligation. SHRUG village polygons have their own entry (shrug-cc-by-nc-sa) after the owner decision of 2026-11-24.

shrug-cc-by-nc-sa.name: SHRUG village polygons, Development Data Lab, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (Census 2011 boundaries)
shrug-cc-by-nc-sa.attribution: Village boundaries: SHRUG, Development Data Lab, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, 2011 Census based; for non-commercial use
shrug-cc-by-nc-sa.decision: Owner chose the non-commercial route on 2026-11-24 (free, no ads, no paid features, no sale of data; see docs/NONCOMMERCIAL.md). Counsel to confirm (a) that a non-profit civic operator qualifies as non-commercial and (b) the share-alike scope: derived boundary files (data/generated/geo/villages-shrug/) must be offered under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; app code is unaffected while the boundaries stay a separate data layer. If any commercial use is planned, set COMMERCIAL_USE=1: the compliance test then fails until the SHRUG layer is removed or a commercial licence is obtained from Development Data Lab.
shrug-cc-by-nc-sa.evidence: devdatalab.org/shrug and /shrug_download/ read 2026-11-24: 'licensed under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0', 'commercial use ... please contact our team'. The README inside shrug-pc11-village-poly-shp.zip (SHRUG v2.2, Copyright 2026 Development Data Lab) repeats the CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 grant. The file is a pre-signed public S3 link listed on the download page; no login, form or checkbox was involved (the page footnote says accepting the data means accepting the DDL disclaimer, which is a no-warranty and no-liability notice).

odbl.name: Open Database Licence (OpenStreetMap)
odbl.decision: data/generated/geo/mandal-AP.geojson and mandal-TG.geojson are derived from OpenStreetMap relations (simplified, re-keyed to LGD). They must stay under ODbL with the OSM attribution, and anyone redistributing them must offer the derived file under ODbL (share-alike). Counsel to confirm that this file is a separable derivative database and that the rest of the repository and the app are not affected, or choose to drop the file. S-90 adds data/generated/geo/village-points-osm-AP.json and village-points-osm-TG.json (OSM place nodes joined to LGD villages, gap fill only). The API merges these points with CC0 Wikidata points in one list (each point has a source field). Counsel to confirm that this is a collective database rather than a derived one, and that attribution to OpenStreetMap contributors must be shown wherever OSM-derived points appear; the OSM file can be dropped without touching the CC0 file. See docs/decisions/S-90-village-boundaries.md. S-191 adds a self-hosted OpenStreetMap background (Protomaps extract of AP and TG, data/basemap/ap-tg.pmtiles, not in git) shown behind the boundary shapes, served by this site and credited on the map as 'OpenStreetMap contributors'. Counsel to confirm the attribution wording is enough, and to check how foreign-compiled data draws India's external borders (this app drops the border layer and keeps only place names). See docs/BASEMAP.md.
odbl.evidence: Standard licence terms (https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright states ODbL 1.0 and the attribution wording). Applied in S-89 and S-90.
